description: Read one oracle-trust snapshot or historical series for an asset. Use it for a one-off check of whether a symbol is currently trustworthy or how its recent history looks. Do not use it for continuous monitoring — buy a 24h window with oracle_watch_window_begin. Returns the current trust signal (or the requested history series) with provider participation and freshness. Deprecated alias: prefer oracle_watch_window with op "snapshot". Removed on 2027-01-06.
name: oracle_watch
